editionStmt.edition: TEI Lex-0 digital edition, transduced from a Lexware (Shoebox/MDF-style) database reconstructed from the original 1988 WordStar/CP-M source files.

sourceDesc.p: Reconstructed from the salvaged WordStar source files of "The Dictionary of Lahu" (University of California Press, 1988) via src/dl_convert.py (WordStar -> Unicode + Lexware) and src/lex2xml.py (Lexware -> ad hoc XML), then transduced to TEI Lex-0 by src/lahu-to-tei.xsl. See ../README.md for the full pipeline.

editorialDecl.p: Each Lexware "band" tag becomes a TEI element or attribute as follows (see README-tei.md for the full worked mapping and rationale):

hw / (sub)hw -> form/orth (xml:lang="lhu"); pos -> gramGrp/gram[@type='pos']; ld -> usg[@type='etym'] (loanword flag); bz -> usg[@type='label'] (bracketed register/dialect/ cross-reference annotations such as [RL], [poetic], [q.v.]môi, bracket stripped); gl not preceded by an ex sibling -> sense/def (with sense/@n split out when the gloss begins with a short numeric or single-letter marker, e.g. "2. " or "b. "); gl immediately preceded by an ex sibling -> that example's translation (cit[@type='translation']/quote); ex -> cit[@type='example']/quote (xml:lang="lhu"); no -> note; sub-entries (Lexware "sub") -> re; err / xx / srcxcrN (pipeline diagnostics and raw fallback content -- see README-lex2xml.md) -> note[@type='editorial'], suppressed by default in the rendering stylesheets.

Sense numbering: only the FIRST run of definitional gl bands (before the first example) is treated as a set of senses; any numeric/letter prefix embedded in that gloss text (Matisoff's own "1. ", "2. ", "a. ", "b. " convention) is split out into sense/@n. This is a best-effort heuristic (see README-tei.md); when it doesn't match, the gloss is kept as a single unnumbered sense rather than guessed at.

namespace.name: http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0
namespace.tagUsage: Headword form. type=lemma for the main entry; type=compound for a sub-entry.
Orthographic form, xml:lang=lhu (Lahu, in Matisoff's romanization with tone diacritics).
Usage note. type=etym for the loanword flag (Lexware "ld"); type=label for bracketed register/dialect/ cross-reference annotations (Lexware "bz").
One sense. n= for an explicitly numbered sense (see editorialDecl above).
type=example wraps a Lahu example sentence and, when present, its translation (type=translation).
The quoted text within a cit.
Lexicographic note (Lexware "no"), or, when type=editorial, a pipeline diagnostic (Lexware "err"/"xx"/ "srcxcrN") shown only when rendering with show-editorial-notes=1.

sense.def: be slanted precariously; be toppling over under its own weight

cit.quote: há-pɨ=šī chi tê phā mâ a lɔ -- thê ɛ̀ qay šɔ̄
This bunch of stones is not at all slanted over -- they're still quite straight.

sense.def: slanted but not supported by anything (as a car going very fast around a corner)
